pr_title: Add ability for skins to have more control over judgement transforms
pr_body:
Closes #10195.

Can be tested with existing test scene (`osu.Game.Rulesets.Osu.Tests.TestSceneDrawableJudgement`) – special skin is animated and should no longer show a scale transform on misses *or* hits. All others should remain as previous.

Ended up implementing this in a non-breaking way (I believe).

![2020-11-17 15 51 53](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/99356070-d8d28400-28ec-11eb-923c-bf327e412121.gif)

issue_context.title: For legacy skins, judgements should use animations that match stable
issue_context.body:
Re-opening #6420 under this name

**Describe the bug:** 
Legacy skin judgements use different animation effects on stable than they do on lazer. On lazer they pop out from middle regardless of if the judgements are animated or not, on stable they fade in if they are animated and only pop out if not.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
https://youtu.be/Je50_IcAmFs
lazer is on left, stable on right, using [my skin](https://github.com/LittleEndu/osuSkin/tree/master/u200B)

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.910.0
